premises.text: Businesses run on painful reply-all email threads and need email made more productive, collaborative, and social rather than replaced
premises.evidence_span: Businesses almost all run on these kind of reply all threads. And it's totally stupid

premises.text: A Loop is a named email-addressable smart list created via email and backed by SaaS without IT installs or new behavior
premises.evidence_span: The loop is a smart mailing list easy to search, easy to share, easy to create

premises.text: Web UI searches threads and attachments and suggests related loops to follow with digest or web-only options
premises.evidence_span: You know, web interface has all the threads, all the content, all the attachments. It has great search

premises.text: Open loops and footer/partner/website invites create email-native virality that supports freemium
premises.evidence_span: email lists are just intrinsically viral

premises.text: Customers pay for customization, administration, and integrations such as Google Apps, Dropbox, and Salesforce
premises.evidence_span: customers have told us they'll pay for customization

value.text: Workplace email becomes more productive, collaborative, and social without forcing users off email
value.evidence_span: make email more productive, so you waste less time in it, more collaborative, and more social

causal_links.evidence_span: We don't ask for behavior changes, because it's just email

notes: Transcript ends mid-CTA (truncated=true). Reply-all pain folded as one problem (§4.1.6). Create-via-email, search, suggestions, follow/digest, and virality folded as cascade of email-native Loop mechanism (§4.1.7). Paid customization/admin/integrations as commercial package. Team/investor bio excluded. Anti-template: problem, product, and freemium packaging separately revisable.
